body: Per docs2/NORTHSTAR.md §7's design record: a port, not a fresh build. SHANKPIT's procedural PCM synthesis engine (MIDI-style weapon sounds, pentatonic footsteps, sin(angle) spatial panning + distance rolloff) carried over unchanged, wrapped behind a new SoundEngine vtable interface (play_weapon/play_footstep/play_ambient/shutdown) per NORTHSTAR §7's own instruction -- a future real-asset backend can be a second implementation behind the same call sites. play_ambient added as a real callable no-op (didn't exist in SHANKPIT's original) since no ambient content is designed yet. Wired audio_init/shutdown into main(), audio_play_weapon into the existing shooting-edge-detection point, spatialized against the local listener. Footstep/ambient call-site wiring not attempted -- no existing movement-cadence hook, flagged as real follow-on. 11 new unit tests for the spatial-gain math (position/panning/rolloff/yaw all verified). Both binaries build clean. Real server+bot regression test PASS. Client verified live under Xvfb: starts clean, audio's own graceful no-device fallback logs and continues normally, not a crash. Commit 9904e04.
title: S169-09: spatial audio backported from SHANKPIT
